description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
